name: Short Rest
reason: Row retained with all source cells; automatic mapping not claimed.

columns.Effect: A period of relative safety with no strenuous activity. You may spend Hit Dice; for each die spent, roll it and regain HP equal to the result + your Constitution modifier. Recover features that say they return on a short rest. Warp Pressure is reduced to 0 as described in Chapter 15.

name: Long Rest
reason: Row retained with all source cells; automatic mapping not claimed.

columns.Effect: At least 6 hours should be sleep or an equivalent species-appropriate rest unless the GM rules otherwise. Restore all lost HP, recover long-rest features and regain spent Hit Dice up to half your total Hit Dice, minimum one. Warp Pressure is reduced to 0. A character can normally benefit from only one long rest in 24 hours.
